note: Each case: a certificate (DER, hex) issued by one of `issuers` (test keys, not MOICA's), the path of its serial number (revocation-tree.json), `current_time`, and the card's signatures (hex) over the scope string and the declaration code; `inputs` is the circuit's input map and `public_inputs` the public inputs the proof must carry, in order. In `inputs`, `tbs`, `scope` and `declaration_code` are byte arrays written as hex; every other number is 0x-prefixed, 64 hex digits, big-endian. The circuits in web/circuits/ accept every case.
